## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Duplicate adoption output should be fixed because the command renders adoption records after the planner has already emitted their progress messages.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption records and setting-count audit metadata to returned plans while retaining adoption progress output. It adds tests for audit records and empty input.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Skip adoption records when rendering command output — With `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)`, your command emits `Adopted theme` twice. The planner emits progress at line 8, then `app/cli.py:9` emits the newly returned adoption record again. — Users adopting existing settings receive duplicate progress messages, making each adoption appear to have occurred twice. — Fix: Preserve planner progress output, exclude adoption records from command rendering, and extend `test_adoption_progress` to cover `run`.

(none)
